name: Life Drain
primary:
The classic vampire spell. For 3 s a crimson stream flows from the first foe along your aim (up to 20 blocks) into your hand. Every 0.5 s:
• Drains 1 ❤ from the victim
• Heals you by the same amount
self_description: Your heart beats loudly for 3 s. Every second each foe within 6 blocks loses 1 ❤ and it flows into you.
